The design system

One palette, one type scale, one spacing rhythm. Every page is generated with these tokens, so a new tool cannot be off-brand — it does not declare its own colours. Every pair below passes WCAG in both themes; that was checked, not eyeballed.

Components built only from tokens

A finding

The accent appears on interactive things and the one number you are meant to look at. Semantic colours stay separate from it, so a clean result and a call to action never compete.
